messages:
nora: Quick ask — can we swap the ARB slot next Wed? I need to be OOO. Proposing a compact agenda + a light facilitator rotation.

linh: I can cover next Wed (Mar 25). Happy to run a condensed agenda.

emma: +1, thx Linh. Can we keep it to 40m? I'm heads-down but can join for the RFCs.

raj: Okay with 40m. Can we prioritize RFC-198 and a quick triage of perf regressions? I'll bring status on RFC-204.

carlos: pinging @owners for RFC-198 (tomas), RFC-204 (maya) — can owners confirm they'll be ready?

tomas: (in thread) I'll be there for RFC-198, slides incoming.

maya: RFC-204 is blocked on infra test; can give demo if we skip deep infra details.

nora: Thanks. Proposed compact agenda (timeboxed):
```
- 5m: quick context + facilitator intro
- 15m: RFC-198 (tomas) — decision: accept / follow-up
- 10m: Design quick-check — KV caching improvements (Linh)
- 5m: RFC-204 status & next steps (maya/raj)
- 5m: triage & blockers (open PRs / regressions)
```
If that's OK I'll publish and set facilitator = Linh for that slot.

linh: Sounds good. I'll swap facil duties with Nora for that week. Can someone add a 1‑pager link for RFC-198 in the agenda doc?

emma: I'll add a short note about the performance measurements to the doc. Also suggest we add an explicit fallback policy checkbox for rolling changes.

raj: Also, quick ask — can we move the triage item earlier if we have fewer RFCs? Might unblock folks faster.

nora: Fine with that. Final call: Linh facilitates, agenda posted as above, timeboxed to 40m. I'll update calendar invite and add follow-up owners.

triage-bot: Reminder: incident blurb must be <30s; mark "no incidents" if none reported.

carlos: I've updated the calendar and added links: agenda doc + RFC links.

emma: RSVP: ✅ I'll be there for first 30m, might leave early.

linh: Got it. I'll prep slides and a 1‑pager link before EOD Tue.

nora: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything urgent, drop comments on the agenda doc; otherwise see you (virtually) next Wed.
